RaggieSoft Studio • Accessible Interactive Launchpads & Collector Menus

RaggieSoft Showcase Studio — 1990s CD-ROM Magic, Rebuilt with WCAG 2.2 AA Safeguards.

Remember opening a boxed PC release in 1996 and greeting an illustrated multimedia launchpad with custom artwork, liner notes, bonus tracks, and one-click install actions? RaggieSoft Showcase Studio revives that art form for commemorative USB box sets, downloadable ISO collector editions, multi-package installer suites, offline press kits, and accessible classroom kiosks—compiling plain-text .rssp projects into zero-dependency static /MT Win32 C++20 executables for x64 and ARM64.

Interactive Era & Workstation Switcher (Click Any Tab, Then Click Image for 1:1 Zoom)

Classic 1990s Painted .BMP Aesthetic — Fixed for Every User: Keep authentic #008080 / #000080 desktop washes, beveled #C0C0C0 frames, and custom pixel art while automatically adding dual-ring keyboard focus indicators, Alt+Key accelerators, real Win32 UI Automation screen-reader peers, and live Windows Contrast Theme fallback.

Modern Windows 11 FluentMica Widescreen Mode: Render a crisp Per-Monitor V2 DPI 16:9 collector launchpad with category rails, accessible Dark/Light action cards, captioned audio previews, and direct handoff to signed Setup.exe / .msi installers.

Visual Page, Hotspot & 4-Way Focus-Matrix Authoring: Map pages, hotspots, directional Up/Down/Left/Right arrow routing, UI Automation labels, and High-Contrast previews inside a native Win32 C++20 workstation IDE.

Inspect 1990s .BMP Mode, Modern FluentMica Mode & the Canvas IDE

Showcase Studio Runtime • 1990s .BMP Mode + WCAG 2.2 AA Safeguards

1990s Painted .BMP CD-ROM Showcase — Upgraded with Modern Accessibility

In the 1990s, painted bitmap menus were completely inaccessible to blind, low-vision, and keyboard-only users because buttons were just flat pixels on a single background image. Showcase Studio solves this cleanly in Win32 C++20: authors place rectangular or polygon hotspots over any retro .BMP/.PNG canvas, and the runtime creates real windowless/child UI Automation Button peers with Alt+Key mnemonics, dual black/gold high-contrast focus frames, and automatic OS Contrast Theme fallback.
Showcase Studio Runtime • Windows 11 FluentMica 16:9 Mode

Modern Windows 11 FluentMica 16:9 Collector’s Edition Launchpad

Designed for USB box sets, downloadable ISO collector editions, multi-package suite front-ends, offline press kits, and museum or classroom kiosks—booting in under 40ms from static /MT C++20 on x64 and ARM64 with zero browser engine bloat.
ShowcaseStudio.exe • Visual Page, Hotspot & Focus-Matrix IDE

ShowcaseStudio.exe — Visual Canvas, 4-Way Focus Graph & WCAG Inspector

Borrowing the best ideas from classic card-based multimedia builders and set-top disc authoring tools, the central canvas draws explicit directional focus links (FocusUp, FocusDown, FocusLeft, FocusRight) and refuses to compile unlabeled hotspots unless every interactive region exposes a human-readable UI Automation name.
Accessibility Engineering Deep Dive

How Showcase Studio Solves Six Classic 1990s Multimedia Accessibility Failures

1990s Bitmap Menu Limitations vs. RaggieSoft Showcase Studio Win32 C++20 Safeguards
1990s CD-ROM Menu Failure Showcase Studio Runtime Safeguard Standard Met
Flat painted pixels invisible to screen readers Every canvas hotspot spawns a synchronized Win32 child BUTTON / IAccessible UI Automation proxy exposing Name, Description, Role, and Shortcut to Narrator, NVDA, and JAWS WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 & Section 508 502.3
Mouse-only hover regions with zero keyboard access Deterministic Tab order plus explicit 4-way FocusUp / Down / Left / Right arrow & Xbox/D-pad focus matrix rendered with a high-contrast dual black/gold outer/inner focus frame WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 & SC 2.4.11
Hardcoded bitmaps illegible in High Contrast Listens for SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST and WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE, automatically replacing decorative bitmaps with crisp COLOR_WINDOW, COLOR_WINDOWTEXT, and 2px COLOR_HIGHLIGHT semantic cards WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 & Section 508 502.2
Tiny fixed 640×480 postage stamp on 4K displays Per-Monitor V2 DPI scaling with selectable integer nearest-neighbor pixel-art upscaling (preserving razor-sharp retro pixels!) or vector layout reflow WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 & SC 1.4.10
Unstoppable loud startup music loops Audio is muted or opt-in by default (AutoPlayAudio = false), provides a persistent Alt+M Mute toggle, and supports synchronized .vtt caption overlays for spoken commentary WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.2 & SC 1.2.2
Flashing transitions & forced animations Queries OS animation preferences (SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION) to disable wipes/particles automatically when reduced motion is enabled WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3
Plain-Text Authoring • Compiles to Zero-Dependency x64 & ARM64

Draft Plain-Text .rssp Showcase Project Grammar

; Sample .rssp manifest — supports both 1990s .BMP retro art & modern FluentMica!
[Showcase]
Title             = RaggieSoft Collector's Box Set
Version           = 1.0.0
PresentationStyle = retro_bmp95          ; retro_bmp95 | fluentmica_16x9 | kiosk_fullscreen
CanvasSize        = 800x600
IntegerPixelScale = true
BackdropWash      = #008080
AutoPlayAudio     = false                ; Enforced false by default for WCAG 1.4.2

[Page.MainMenu]
BackgroundBitmap  = .artoxset-main-800x600.bmp
HighContrastTitle = Collector's Box Set — Main Menu

[Hotspot.InstallApps]
Page              = MainMenu
Bounds            = 48, 132, 312, 64
Label             = &Install Desktop Applications
Description       = Launches the signed x64 and ARM64 application suite installer.
Action            = run_installer
Target            = .packages
aggiesoft-apps-setup.exe
FocusDown         = BrowseBooks
FocusRight        = PlaySoundtrack

[Hotspot.BrowseBooks]
Page              = MainMenu
Bounds            = 48, 212, 312, 64
Label             = Open Offline &Book Library
Description       = Opens the illustrated Ocean View Archives offline reader.
Action            = goto_page
TargetPage        = BooksShelf
FocusUp           = InstallApps
